`final class GlShader`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.shader` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlShader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/shader/GlShader.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

A shader program of OpenGL, linked from the translation of the two stages of a JOID shader.

## Description

A compilation or a link error prints the log of the driver and leaves the shader inactive, without throwing.

## Learn more

- [Textures, framebuffers, shaders](/build/base-modules/opengl/#textures-framebuffers-shaders)

## Creation details

<a id="GlShader-factory-create"></a>

### create

`GlShader create(GlRenderBridge bridge, ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment, BlendState blend)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the shader, translated to the dialect of the context with loose uniforms; [`GlRenderBridge.createShader`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/#GlRenderBridge-method-createShader) calls it.

## Method details

<a id="GlShader-method-use"></a>

### use

`void use(RenderState state, VertexBuffer buffer)` 

Makes the program current and uploads its built-in uniforms and its uniform values, for a draw with that state and those vertices.

<a id="GlShader-method-getLocation"></a>

### getLocation

`int getLocation(String name)` 

Returns the location of a uniform, cached per name, or `-1` when the program has none.

<a id="GlShader-method-getProgram"></a>

### getProgram

`int getProgram()` 

Returns the OpenGL name of the program, `0` once deleted.

<a id="GlShader-method-isProgramActive"></a>

### isProgramActive

`boolean isProgramActive()` 

If `true`, the program compiled and linked.
